method: Re-checked my v1 blockers A1-C2-01/02 against v2 text without treating resolves as closed.
Workflow enumeration (query-only, fit, graph rules, yagni, sim/probe, scanner, repair verify) → which stage/host activity owns each — different from author's stage list walk.
Compared ExecutionPlan kinds to architecture/05 stage table for restatement drift.
Asked whether PS-09/PS-12 can be true given ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT REOPENED and provider/scanner effect surfaces.
PS-07: ask what would make the test pass while private operators still leak into public schema.
Did not use Reviewer B's C2 findings as a checklist (read only after drafting; overlap noted in log).
whatCouldHaveFailed: InvocationPlan still silent on admission (A1-C2-01 open)
PS-07 still two public Plans (A2-C2-V1-03 open)

A1-C2-01.detail: InvocationPlan explicitly covers config resolution, contribution admission, capability grants, scope, snapshot, PlanId/ExecutionId allocation; failureBefore is pre-admission. This is the sentence v1 lacked.

A1-C2-02.detail: PS-07 correctly rewritten to one public ExecutionPlan + test-only dual physical strategies with exact-Coverage-first. Harness still does not exist (knownLimitations). Spec shape is sealable; discharge is not.

A2-C2-V1-01.detail: Two-level model removes Snapshotter-before-Planner vs snapshot-stage contradiction for the inner Plan. architecture/05 still lists Snapshot as a plan stage kind — restatement not updated.

A2-C2-V1-02.detail: Compound Coverage key (relation × language/universe × subject-scope) + consumer status. Field-level schema still missing.

A2-C2-V1-03.detail: PS-07 rewrite matches required shape; implementation owed.

A2-C2-V1-04.detail: PS-09 states runtime denial; no capability substrate (knownLimitation). ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT REOPENED for the same reason. Enum still cannot prove capability.

A2-C2-V1-05.detail: requiredness + PS-10 force indeterminate on required fault/budget. Good.

findings.title: architecture/05 still presents Snapshot as a public plan stage; C2 v2 removed it from ExecutionPlan
findings.detail: 05's C-2 section table lists Snapshot | Fact derivation | Rule | Policy | Probe as plan stage kinds. v2 ExecutionPlan.stageKinds has four kinds and containsSnapshotStage=false. Claim-register C-2 bindingArtifact still points at c2-plan-stage-schema.v1.json. Readers of SEALED-looking stage tables get a different contract than the candidate artifact.
findings.requiredFix: Update 05 to InvocationPlan vs ExecutionPlan (mark CANDIDATE); retarget claim-register bindingArtifact to v2; CHK-style restatement if registered.

findings.title: PS-12 / sealedProperties 'effectful only as probe' overclaims against provider and scanner surfaces
findings.detail: Architecture execution tiers include external scanners and guest/semantic-provider processes that are effectful or ambient-authority. PS-12 says effectful work is representable only as probe; PS-09 only denies effects on rule-evaluation labels. Fact-derivation via a provider that executes repository-controlled code (TM V9) is not a Probe stage yet is effectful. Either expand stage model / host supervision boundary, or narrow PS-12 to 'Rules cannot be effectful' without claiming Probe exclusivity for all effects.
findings.requiredFix: Align PS-12 with reopened ARCH.PROBE-CONTRACT: forbid effectful Rules; place scanners/providers under named host supervision outside rule-evaluation; do not discharge 'effectful unrepresentable as Rule' via Probe-only wording alone.

findings.title: PS-09 has no enforcement substrate — same Error-2 class as signature-as-boundary
findings.detail: knownLimitations admit this. sealedPropertiesCovered still lists effectful-unrepresentable dischargedBy PS-09/PS-12. That is discharging a sealed property with an unimplemented test — paper seal risk.
findings.requiredFix: Remove from sealedPropertiesCovered discharge until a capability-matrix artifact exists; or mark discharge CONDITIONAL.

findings.title: External scanner workflow has no stage kind and no InvocationPlan home
findings.detail: Product surface includes scanner adapters. Workflow enumeration: where does trivy/gitleaks-class work sit? Not fact-derivation (different authority), not probe (unless forced), not private operator (produces findings). Silence will invent a fifth public kind later — same failure mode as A1-C2-01 for admission.
findings.requiredFix: State scanners as host-supervised stages with a result contract, or as a subclass of probe, or as fact-derivation producers with explicit non-rule authority — pick one and put it in the schema narrative.

findings.title: PS-07 still unimplementable without harness; gaming path remains
findings.detail: Test-only physical planner is specified not built. An implementer can skip PS-07 or expose operators. Acceptable for candidate if seal blocked; not a discharge of private-operator privacy alone.
findings.requiredFix: Keep A1-C2-02 as seal blocker until harness API exists or PS-07 is redefined to an already-testable warmth/shard invariant with explicit non-claim about operator privacy.

findings.title: domainResults createsRun:true for all analysis results may over-create Runs for pure reduction queries
findings.detail: reduction candidates createsRun true. If reduction is a query profile over stored facts, creating a Run contradicts queryNeverRunsAnalysis. If reduction is always an admitted analysis Plan, state that — otherwise agents get spurious Runs.
findings.requiredFix: Split reduction-as-query vs reduction-as-analysis in domainResults.

findings.title: Field-level stage schemas still absent
findings.detail: Acknowledged. Blocks implementability of PS-01/02 round-trip claims.
findings.requiredFix: Minimal JSON schemas per kind before seal.

invocationPlanVerdict.detail: Naming outer host work beats deleting snapshot from existence. Alternative (snapshot wholly outside any plan concept) loses a place to hang snapshot failure taxonomy; InvocationPlan is fine.
invocationPlanVerdict.whatWouldChangeMyMind: Evidence that InvocationPlan becomes a dumping ground for every host concern and reintroduces four products under a new name.

sealRecommendation: Do not seal C-2. v2 is a real advance on v1 blockers; capability substrate, 05 restatement, and scanner/provider effect boundary remain.
whatWouldChangeMyMind: Capability-denial artifact + 05/register aligned + PS-12 narrowed + scanner placement stated + PS-07 harness or honest non-discharge.
knownLimitations: Did not design the capability matrix.
Did not read B's C2 review until after drafting findings; A1-C2V2-02/03 likely overlap B-C2V2 — independent method was architecture tier table + TM V9, not B's list.
sealedPropertiesCovered: C-2 one mechanism typed stages (candidate v2)
